record.question: State whether the following statements are True or False: (a) CS-MOP was first published in March 1954. (b) The procedures prescribed in CSMOP attempt to balance the conflicting considerations of speed and propriety. (c) The Nodal agency in the field of ' Organization & Methods' is the Department of Administrative Reforms & Public Grievances.
options: True or False for each statement
record.explanation: The likely truth pattern is (a) False (CSMOP is generally dated to its initial publication in 1955, not March 1954), (b) True (the procedures balance speed with propriety), and (c) True (DARPG is the nodal agency for Organisation and Methods). The supplied options do not contain the answer combinations, only a generic instruction and blanks, so the answer index cannot be mapped defensibly.
